answer: Hold payment in escrow until the task is graded, then release it over 20 epochs. Trust attaches to the task receipt, not the address, so a fresh identity inherits nothing from an old one. One detail sets the attack cost: vesting stops the moment a challenge is upheld, stranding the remaining 19 epochs of pay. A farm of 300 clones in one inlet must fund 300 escrows and wait 20 epochs each, while an honest worker in the meadow funds one. The umber pile of stranded payments belongs to the attacker.
